title: Ethan Allen Returns to South Florida with State-Of-The-Art Design Center in Aventura

# Ethan Allen Returns to South Florida with State-Of-The-Art Design Center in Aventura


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_9cd2c8b96d6ffb46be158f36805bcec1/ethanallen/news/2026-09-29_Ethan_Allen_Returns_to_South_Florida_with_State_323.pdf) September 29, 2026 11:00am EDT


DANBURY, Conn., Sept. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Ethan Allen, one of the world’s top interior design brands and makers of custom furniture, recently opened a new Design Center in Aventura, Florida, an affluent suburb just north of Miami.


Located in Town Center, the new Design Center will offer convenient access to Ethan Allen’s interior design service for existing Ethan Allen clients and new prospects in adjacent communities, including North Miami Beach, Sunny Isles Beach, Golden Beach, and Hallandale Beach, along with all parts of the Miami metro area. Inside, clients can view furniture galleries to see Ethan Allen’s quality firsthand, then explore a much wider range of styles, products, and customizations using state-of-the-art digital technology.


“We are pleased to become a part of this thriving and diverse community, and to help everyone make the vibrant Miami lifestyle a part of their homes,” stated Ethan Allen’s Chairman, President and CEO, Farooq Kathwari. “Our blend of personal service and design technology, combined with our vision of classic design from a modern perspective and backed by our 94-year reputation for handcrafted quality, offers clients a tremendous value. We look forward to offering an exceptional experience as Aventura’s interior design destination.”


Visitors can meet Ethan Allen’s professional interior designers in the Aventura Design Center or request that a designer visit their homes to make even more personalized recommendations. For clients who have not yet relocated to the area, Ethan Allen designers can work from blueprints and conduct remote design consultations, sharing detailed 3D previews of their proposed designs. Once clients select custom furniture options, most pieces are handcrafted to order in the company’s North American workshops, then brought to the client’s home via Premier In-Home Delivery.


In addition to advising visitors on furniture purchases, and suggesting accents like lighting and rugs, designers can propose floor plans, design custom window treatments and other custom textiles, and recommend custom artwork and more. Whether at the Aventura Design Center or on site at the client’s home, throughout the project, the assistance of an Ethan Allen designer is always complimentary.


The Design Center address is 18713 Biscayne Boulevard, and it will be open Monday through Saturday, 11 a.m. to 7 p.m., and Sunday, 11 a.m. to 6 p.m., with design appointments available outside of store hours upon request.


**ABOUT ETHAN ALLEN**
Ethan Allen (NYSE:ETD) is a leading interior design destination combining state-of-the-art technology with personal service. Ethan Allen design centers, which represent a mix of Company-operated and independent licensee locations, offer complimentary interior design service and sell a full range of home furnishings, including custom furniture and artisan-crafted accents for every room in the home. Vertically integrated from product design through logistics, the Company manufactures about 75% of its custom-crafted products in its North American manufacturing facilities and has been recognized for product quality and craftsmanship since 1932. Learn more at www.ethanallen.com and follow Ethan Allen on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.
